profile.headline: Senior Software Developer | Legacy Systems & Integrations | Delphi Specialist | Contract / Part-Time
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary:
Experienced software developer with 30+ years in enterprise application development, including 25 years supporting medical and government systems.

Skilled in Delphi, database-driven applications, and full lifecycle development, with extensive experience stabilizing and maintaining long-lived production systems. Comfortable working within complex legacy environments, improving reliability, and documenting systems clearly for long-term sustainability.

Known for being steady, dependable, and focused on solving problems without drama.

Previously held VA MBI clearance (2020). Currently available for selective remote contract or part-time engagements where deep experience and reliability are valued.

positions.title: Software Developer – Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS)
positions.description:
Contract concluded July 2025.  Led AWS Workspace support and Cloud-Ops activities for CMS contract. Provided technical support for a large user base, maintained workspace security and compliance, and managed server environments.

Highlights:

Supported AWS Workspace setup, configuration, Workspace migration, and certificate renewals

Troubleshot user access issues and managed workspace patching
Performed security vulnerability scans and environment updates
Wrote and maintained documentation for cloud operations
Provided frontline technical support and coordinated with stakeholders

positions.title: Software Developer – Department of Veterans Affairs (VA)
positions.description:
Technical lead for CAPRI, a Delphi-based application interfacing with MUMPS. Responsible for system enhancements, testing, source control, and compliance documentation.

Highlights:

Led development and release of CAPRI software patches
Created test plans and managed end-to-end application lifecycle
Participated in code reviews and compliance documentation (VIP standards)
Mentored junior developers and coordinated with PMs and QA teams
Used IBM Rational Team Concert (Jazz) for version control

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Remote / Department of Veterans Affairs
Performed similar role to ASG above, with a focus on early Delphi modernization efforts.

Highlights:

Led initiative to evaluate Delphi upgrade feasibility
Produced documentation aligned with PMAS standards
Participated in WPRs and served as dev lead for CAPRI
Supported full software lifecycle from planning to support

company.name: Systems Made Simple, a Leidos Company

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on FDA-regulated software for medical devices using Delphi, assembly, and real-time operating systems.

Highlights:

Migrated embedded software from PDOS to Windows XP Embedded
Developed custom real-time OS for 8031 microcontroller
Created UI, database, and display tools for clinical data collection
Supported ISO/FDA documentation and compliance
Built internal web tools for field service teams

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Highlights:

Built Oracle/Delphi software for corporate wellness programs
Worked on longitudinal patient records using C on Tandem systems
